title: The THonly Research Corpus
description:
A corpus of defensive publications and essays on gratitude infrastructure, reciprocity economics, AI succession and institutional design, developed alongside HeartBank(R). Every paper is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.

The defensive publications exist to establish prior art and to keep the mechanisms they describe freely practicable: no patent is or will be sought on anything in this corpus. The essays are in the author's own voice and make no such claim.

The canonical version of every paper is at thonly.org/research. Each document is independently timestamped to the Bitcoin blockchain via OpenTimestamps and signed under RFC 3161 by three trust authorities, one of them eIDAS-qualified; see TIMESTAMPS.md and timestamps/README.md.

AI co-authorship is disclosed. Miss Aquarius is the consistent name used for the AI collaboration across all venues.
